Siteline is a fast-growing Series A startup transforming how construction companies get paid, headquartered in San Francisco.

We’re changing that.

Construction is the slowest paid industry, with contractors waiting around 96 days to get paid. Data centers, hospitals, schools, roads, and power infrastructure still have to be built -and the contractors building them need a radically better way to manage their receivables.

**WHY ARE WE BUILDING THIS?**

Construction software has historically been built for General Contractors. We’re building for the subcontractors actually doing the work.

These businesses are managing millions of dollars on spreadsheets, printouts, ERP reports, and a whole lot of manual work to get paid.

Every project has different billing requirements, different deadlines, and different paperwork. Miss something, and payment can get pushed out another 30 days.

Subcontractors deserve software built specifically for them. That’s why we built Siteline.

jobs.desc:
### **You Know the Difference Between a Number that Wins the Job and a Number That Holds Up** **You have probably seen it before.**

An estimate gets approved, the contract gets signed, and construction starts.

Then the misses show up.

A scope nobody priced. A trade quote that left something out. An allowance that was never realistic. Two subs covering the same work, and nobody covering the work in between.

Now the project team is explaining a change order to a client who thought they already had a real number.

That is not how you like to work.

You believe a good estimate is more than a spreadsheet. It takes reading the drawings closely, understanding how a remodel actually gets built, asking the trades the right questions, and tying every line back to a clear scope.

If that sounds like you, HHI Builders may be a place where you can do some of your best work.

We are a growing design-build remodeling company on Hilton Head Island specializing in high-end residential renovations, additions, and whole-home transformations.

We are looking for an Estimator who wants ownership of the numbers and wants to see their estimates carried all the way from the first budget through the finished home.  
  
**Compensation**

$75,000 - $95,000 yearly base salary, based on experience, plus a performance bonus: a percentage of every project you estimate, based on that project's profitability.

Medical insurance through Blue Cross Blue Shield, with HHI Builders paying 50% of the employee premium. Paid time off and paid company holidays.  
  
**You May Be a Great Fit If...**

You are the type of estimator who naturally asks:

“What is not on these drawings that still has to be paid for?”

You read a trade partner's proposal line by line, including the exclusions.

You would rather make one more phone call than carry a guess into a contract.

You enjoy building real relationships with trade partners and suppliers.

You care about scope, quantities, unit costs, and documentation.

We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented Construction Bookkeeper to manage the financial records for our construction businesses.

This position requires someone who can go beyond basic bookkeeping. We need someone who can review every job, track all expenses and income, reconcile bank and credit card transactions, and determine the actual profit or loss on each construction project.

Our goal is to have a clear understanding of where every dollar is going and how profitable each job and business is on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.

Responsibilities:

Review and organize all financial transactions for our construction businesses.

Track every construction project individually.

Review all credit card transactions and identify which job each expense belongs to.

Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, deposits, and payments.

Track material costs, labor, subcontractors, equipment, fuel, permits, and other job expenses.

Compare actual job costs against original estimates and budgets.

Calculate the profitability of every construction project.

Identify jobs that are losing money or going over budget.

Track customer payments, outstanding invoices, and accounts payable.

Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly financial reports.

Provide accurate profit-and-loss reports for each job and each company.

Identify discrepancies, duplicate charges, missing receipts, and unnecessary expenses.

Work closely with ownership to provide accurate financial information for business decisions.

Qualifications:

Previous bookkeeping experience required.

Construction industry bookkeeping experience strongly preferred.

Experience with QuickBooks and construction job costing.

Strong understanding of profit-and-loss statements.

Experience reconciling bank accounts and credit card statements.

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

Ability to analyze numbers and identify problems.

Ability to work independently and take ownership of financial reporting.

---------------------

* **$10 an hour plus 8.5% commission**

* Military construction or engineering experience. The Board can credit your MOS training and duty time from your DD-214, and can count supervision by a military officer or senior NCO in place of a licensed contractor.

Other building or inspection experience can go to the Board for a case-by-case review.

* Apply and tell us which path fits you.

jobs.desc:
**Company and Job Description**

Cransten is revolutionizing the handyman and residential remodeling industry. We distinguish ourselves with dedication to our customers’ satisfaction and our transparency with our employees.

The absolute core of Cransten’s business model is employing highly skilled, service-oriented and trustworthy individuals who intend to increase their skill set and grow within the company. Does that describe you?

As an team member, we will first get an understanding of your skill set. We will determine a course of action to ensure that we cater to your particular strengths and assess the skills that may not yet have been developed. The typical schedule is Monday through Friday during regular business hours, although adjustments can usually be accommodated, within reason. We will schedule 1-2 jobs each day, ranging in scope from ceiling fan installations to a full bathroom remodel, so this is definitely the environment for those who enjoy doing something new each day. Your schedule (hosted on a smartphone app) will detail the time and place, the description of work, anticipated hours required, price estimate and the customer contact information. Prior to your appointments, you will call the customer to confirm, prepare yourself with the appropriate tools, pick up specified material and arrive. You will take photos of the area and collect the customer's signature and if more work is required than initially anticipated, you will adjust the cost (aka change order). You will complete the work with dedication to customer service and quality, and upon completion, take photos and obtain the customer signature.

There are three tiers of experience within our company: Handyman, Journeyman, and Master level. This position is for our Master level. The intention is that whichever level you’re brought on at, we ensure we provide opportunities to advance. Consistent performance with an intention to improve provides recognition and growth.

**Silicon Valley Builders Group · San Jose, CA · Full-time, on-site**

Every permit we pull has to be closed out properly. A permit left open on a finished job can block a homeowner’s next remodel or hold up our next project at that property. We’re adding a coordinator who will own the whole permit process, from application to final inspection, so that nothing gets lost after the crews leave.

**About us**  
Silicon Valley Builders Group is a general contractor serving homeowners associations and residential communities across the South Bay. We handle everything from quick repair work orders to multi-building renovations: siding, decks, waterproofing, painting, structural repairs and more. Our office team works alongside bilingual field crews, and the company is growing.

**About the role**  
In your first year, you’ll build and run our permit system. Every active permit will be tracked from application through final sign-off. You’ll find and close out the older permits that are still open. You’ll catch special inspections early, and closeout paperwork won’t hold up a final. You’ll be the person project managers, engineers and city staff call when they need to know where a permit stands. When permit work is slow, you’ll support our other project coordinators on job setup and paperwork.

* Prepare, submit and track permit applications across multiple city and county online portals, including fees, plan sets, corrections and resubmittals.

* Spot special inspection requirements (such as welding or epoxy anchors) during the permit process, and gather the required sign-offs.
* Track closeout documents by unit or address, including smoke/CO affidavits and disposal/recycling paperwork. Follow up with homeowners, property managers and boards until everything is in.
* Work with engineers so plan sets meet each city’s submission rules

jobs.title: Construction Estimator
jobs.desc:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Serenity is hiring a Construction Estimator to build complete, accurate estimates for commercial and residential projects from about $50,000 to $10 million. You'll work with company leadership, project managers, subcontractors and suppliers, and hand the project team a clean, organized estimate when we win the work.

We value field experience as much as software skills. If you understand labor, sequencing, installation and means and methods, and want to move into preconstruction, we want to hear from you.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Do quantity takeoffs from drawings and specifications.
* Build and maintain complete estimates in Excel, covering materials, labor, equipment and installation.
* Review drawings and specs for scope gaps, conflicts and constructability issues.
* Document questions, clarifications, assumptions, inclusions and exclusions.
* Request, track and compare subcontractor and supplier bids for scope coverage, exclusions and pricing.
* Manage several estimates at once and meet every bid deadline.
* Review estimates with leadership before submission and work in their feedback.
* Hand the project team a complete, organized estimate when a project is awarded.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* 3 to 5 years of construction experience. Hands-on field experience is strongly preferred.
* The ability to read and interpret construction drawings and specifications.
* A working knowledge of sequencing, labor, materials and installation methods.
* Estimating experience is a plus, but not required for the right candidate.
* Strong organization, attention to detail and follow-through on deadlines.
* Comfort asking questions and raising unknowns with project teams, subs and suppliers.

**TOOLS**

* Microsoft Excel (required)
* Microsoft Word and Outlook (required)
* Bluebeam Revu (preferred, used daily for takeoffs and markups)
* JobPlanner (preferred, training provided)

**PAY AND BENEFITS**

* $85,000 to $135,000 per year
* Health, dental and life insurance

* 3-8 years relevant experience

* Or equivalent combination of education and experience

* Understanding of Earned Value Management System

Given the complexity of payroll in the construction industry, understanding prevailing wage laws, union agreements, different pay rates, and compliance with labor regulations is vital for a Payroll Coordinator. **Accounts receivable and lender draws**

* Prepare owner billings on cost-plus jobs, with the supporting cost detail the contract requires

jobs.desc:
**Overview:**

This is a high pressure job, and a great one.

Our Project Coordinator keeps every signed job moving, from contract to final invoice: roof replacements and repairs, insurance claims, water and mold losses, commercial and property management work, solar, and interior rebuilds, all at once. The phone does not stop, homeowners want answers today, adjusters take their time, and crews need materials yesterday.

It sounds busy, and it is. We are also constantly growing and improving our AI team to take repetitive tasks and communication follow up off your plate, so your time goes to the work that needs a person. If that sounds like your kind of day, keep reading.

**What You Will Do:**

* Schedule production across our crews and subcontractors, and make sure the paperwork is complete before a job goes on the calendar.
* Coordinate our sales reps’ schedules and our supervision schedule: inspections, appointments, and supervisor site visits at start, during the job, and at final walk.
* Order measurements and materials, and sequence the other trades on restoration jobs: flooring, drywall, paint, cabinets, HVAC, packout and abatement.
* Keep every job file current in AccuLynx. If it is not in AccuLynx, it did not happen.
* Keep insurance jobs moving: work with adjusters, carriers and third parties, and gather the photos and documents a supplement needs.
* Review subcontractor and supplier invoices, and keep job costs lined up between AccuLynx and QuickBooks.
* Be the customer’s day to day contact, often during the worst week of their year. Stay calm and keep them informed.
* Handle change orders, close jobs out, and work every day alongside our AI team.

*Why it is hard:* Volume surges in hail and monsoon season, constant interruptions, and real accountability. A missed delivery or a missed line on a supplement costs money and a customer’s trust.

At Stancil Services, the finish stage of plumbing is where craftsmanship becomes visible and customer-ready. None

jobs.title: Construction Estimator & Inside Sales
jobs.desc:
About Diamond

Founded in 1974, Diamond Concrete Sawing is one of the Midwest's most trusted concrete sawing and cutting companies. We are family owned, based in Grand Rapids with branches around the state, and our locating work runs under Diamond Locating Services. We saw, drill, and cut concrete on some of the most demanding projects in Michigan, including a lot of MDOT highway and public works, and we locate what is underneath before anyone digs.

We are a company of about 30 people. That means no layers to work through and no waiting a week on a decision. You will know everyone here by name, including the operators running the work you quote.

The Role

This is an estimating and quoting role first, and a sales role second. Every quote at Diamond runs through this seat, whether it came from our outside sales rep, our Director of Service, a bid board, or a contractor who called in cold. The number has to be right, and it has to go out the same day.

You own a job from the moment it is found until it is sold and handed to Service. The first phone call, the questions that define the scope, the quote, the follow-up, and the handoff to dispatch all sit with you. You are the first impression most customers get of us.

The phone rings all day and priorities move. This seat fields inbound calls and email requests, carries a large book of open quotes at a time, and one crew hitting something unexpected in the field can reshuffle your afternoon. If you want a predictable desk, this is not it.

What You Will Do

* Own inbound customer requests and respond the same day.
* Confirm scope, location, access, timing, and special requirements before you quote. Call the client back the same day for anything missing, and ask the questions that change the number.
* Prepare and send quotes for the whole team.
* Follow up on every open quote you own until it is won or lost, and review the losses to find out why.
* Seek out new work daily through bid platforms and other lead sources.
*

jobs.title: Project Manager Assistant
jobs.desc:
Construction Project Assistant – Entry Level | We Will Train

**Not sure what you want to do for a career? That's okay.**

Most people don't grow up thinking about a career in mechanical construction. But it's a huge industry with some great opportunities, and you don't need a college degree or construction experience to get started.

We're a family-owned mechanical construction company with over 400 employees, and we're looking for someone who's ready to learn, work hard, and figure out where they want to go.

What's the Job?

You'll work directly with our project managers, estimators, and field supervisors to help keep construction projects running smoothly.

Some days you'll be tracking down materials or checking on orders. Other days you'll be helping set up new projects, working in Excel, or figuring out how to solve a problem.

A lot of it is behind-the-scenes work, but it's how you'll learn the business.

**We're not expecting you to know how to do all of this. We'll teach you.**

Who We're Looking For

We're less concerned about your résumé and more interested in how you approach work.

* You show up, follow through, and do what you say you'll do.
* You're comfortable with computers and willing to learn Excel.
* You can figure things out instead of waiting for someone to give you every answer.
* You ask questions when you don't understand something.
* You take pride in doing a good job, even with the small stuff.

**No construction experience required. No college degree required. Just bring a good attitude and a willingness to learn.**

Where Can This Lead?

This doesn't have to be your forever job.

You'll get exposure to different parts of the construction business, and if you show initiative and pick things up quickly, there are real opportunities to move into roles like **Project Management or Estimating.**

We're looking for someone who wants to grow into more responsibility, not necessarily someone who wants to be an assistant for the next 10 years.

**About the Role**

We are an outsourced accounting and controller services firm serving construction and home service businesses with $2M–$20M in annual revenue. Our clients are owner-operators — they build homes, remodel kitchens, install HVAC, run service crews. They are excellent at their trade and they need someone who is excellent at the numbers.

As a Construction Controller, you are the financial leader for a portfolio of client businesses. You sit across from the owner and tell them what the numbers mean and what to do about it. You own the relationship, the systems, and the outcome — even when the day-to-day bookkeeping is executed by someone else on your team.

**Who Thrives Here**

The best controllers on our team share a few traits. Read these first — they matter more to us than any single line on your resume.

* **You learn fast.** Show you something once and you've got it. When you hit something you've never done, you find the answer, build the checklist, and don't need to be shown twice.
* **You're organized by system, not by memory.** You run a multi-client book with a repeatable rhythm, so nothing depends on you remembering it at 9pm.
* **You fix the process, not just the problem.** When something takes too long or breaks twice, you redesign it — an import, a template, an integration, a better handoff.

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.desc:
Description:

Summary of Responsibilities

The Office Manager plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth, efficient, and professional operation of a restoration branch. This position oversees administrative functions, supports project and field teams, and maintains accurate documentation to keep jobs moving on schedule. The Office Manger services as the central communication hub, ensuring a high level of service and operational coordination.

With strong attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving skills, the Office Manager helps drive operational excellence and contributes directly to the company’s productivity, customer satisfaction, and overall branch success.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

* Manage day-to-day office operations, provide general administrative leadership, ensure customer satisfaction and drive process improvements.
* Manage the AR process for projects, job file maintenance, vendor list management, and calling on past due accounts.
* Responsible for the overall score of program jobs.
* Ensure compliance with processes and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain accurate project files, including contracts, estimates, invoices, and insurance documentation.
* Assist in reconciling projects budgets, reviewing cost reports, and tracking expenses.
* Motivate, train, and retain administrative support staff.
* Communicate effectively with clients and internal stakeholders.

* Phase 4 — Step into Head Bookkeeper: Ownership divides the shared duties between the two roles and trains you on the rest of the Head Bookkeeper work: month-end close, WIP reporting, journal entries, the monthly meeting with our CPA, year-end, and insurance audit schedules. **About Professional Diversified Flooring, Inc.**

Professional Diversified Flooring was established in 1981 and is a leading provider of commercial flooring solutions. With a workforce exceeding 70 office employees and over 400 field labor, the company specializes in comprehensive flooring services for commercial spaces throughout Los Angeles, Orange County, San Diego, Las Vegas, Phoenix, and surrounding areas. Our portfolio encompasses a wide range of projects, from corporate offices to casinos and from healthcare to hospitality, positioning us not merely as flooring specialists, but as strategic partners in design and construction adding maximum value to our clients and their clients.

**THE ROLE**
------------

Billing at PDF does two things: it bills, and it collects. The Billing Specialist owns both, end to end, for the projects assigned to them — from verifying the contract, through progress billing, pay applications, portal submission, lien releases and retention, to collecting the money and closing the job.

Roughly 60% of your time is billing, 30% is collecting, and 10% is the compliance paperwork that gates payment in construction. You are the customer-facing voice of our accounting department to General Contractor project accountants and End User AP teams, and the person our Project Managers rely on to turn finished work into cash.

This is not a data-entry job. The volume is real — a proficient specialist produces 150–200 billings and around $3 million a month — but the work is judgment: reading a subcontract's billing terms, knowing how much can reasonably be billed on a job, catching an over-billing before the GC does, and knowing how far to push a collection before escalating.

You will report to our Billing Manager and work alongside a small, tight team in our Irvine office

**​Job Summary ​**

**We are seeking a reliable, safety-conscious Ready-Mix Concrete Driver to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for batching support, loading, transporting, and delivering ready-mix concrete to commercial, residential, and infrastructure job sites. You will serve as a primary point of contact on delivery sites, ensuring high-quality customer service, precise slump delivery, and strict adherence to safety standards.**

**​Key Responsibilities**

**​Safe Delivery: Operate a commercial ready-mix concrete truck safely to and from job sites in compliance with DOT regulations and traffic laws. ​**

**On-Site Operations: Safely maneuver vehicles on uneven terrain and tight construction sites. Assemble, attach, and clean discharge chutes to pour concrete into forms, pump hoppers, or wheelbarrows.**

**Vehicle Maintenance & Care: Perform required Pre-Trip and Post-Trip inspections (DVIR). Keep the mixer drum, hopper, and exterior washed down to prevent concrete buildup. Report mechanical issues promptly. ​**

**Customer Service & Communication: Maintain professional communication with dispatchers, plant operators, site superintendents, and contractors. Secure signed delivery tickets or electronic receipts. ​**

**Safety Compliance: Adhere to all OSHA, DOT, company, and site-specific safety rules, including wearing required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) at all times. ​**

**Qualifications & Requirements ​Driver's License: Active Class A or Class B Commercial Driver's License (CDL) with an acceptable driving record. (Tanker endorsement or Air Brakes endorsement may be required). ​Medical Certification: Current DOT Medical Card (or ability to pass a DOT physical and drug screen). ​**

* *Example:* On a **$20,000** job, Ripple retains **$3,000** (15%). If direct costs are $11,000, the profit pool is $6,000. **You pocket $5,400 (90%).**
* **Team Building & Mentorship (10% Recruiter Override):** Recruit and mentor reps to build a recurring passive income stream. You receive **10% of the net profit** earned on every job closed by reps you recruit.
* *Example:* When a rep you recruited nets a $6,000 profit pool on a project, **you earn a $600 passive override** for mentoring them.

Position Summary

The AP & AR Specialist is responsible for ensuring that the accounting system accurately and promptly reflects what the company owes and what it has earned. The position owns accounts payable and the assigned accounts receivable functions. It ensures expenses are properly coded, documented, reconciled, and paid on time, and that completed work and approved changes become timely, accurate customer billings.

The role directly impacts cash flow, cash-flow planning, job-cost accuracy, month-end reporting, vendor relationships, and the company’s ability to understand true project profitability. Unentered invoices understate expenses and liabilities, can make profitability appear stronger than it is, and leave management with an incomplete view of upcoming cash needs; delayed billings and unrecorded receipts hold back or obscure cash the company has already earned. The objective is not speed alone, but accurate, efficient, and consistent processing that keeps the books as close to real time as practical. Marex Services Group is a technology-enabled logistics company delivering high-impact transportation solutions across industrial, construction, energy, infrastructure, and specialized project markets. For the right person, the schedule is a plus: weekdays off for appointments and errands, and real ownership of the desk early in your career.

**Position Overview**

The Logistics Coordinator keeps a high-volume open-deck desk moving. You will book, track, and close out spot and project loads of precast, pipe, steel, and scaffolding, and you will be the first person carriers and customers hear from when something changes.

This is an early-career

-----------

An established commercial general contractor is seeking an experienced **Construction Estimator** to support commercial tenant improvements, hospitality renovations, restaurant buildouts, and interior construction projects throughout Southern California.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Prepare detailed cost estimates for commercial tenant improvements, hospitality, restaurant, and renovation projects
* Review construction drawings, specifications, and bid documents to develop accurate project pricing
* Perform quantity takeoffs and prepare material, labor, equipment, and subcontractor cost estimates
* Solicit, review, and evaluate subcontractor and vendor proposals
* Develop bid packages, project budgets, and comprehensive cost breakdowns
* Identify scope gaps, constructability concerns, and potential project risks during the estimating process
* Coordinate with subcontractors, suppliers, architects, and project teams to clarify project requirements
* Participate in pre-bid meetings, site walks, and project evaluations
* Support value engineering and identify cost-effective construction alternatives
* Assist with subcontractor negotiations, bid leveling, and project buyout
* Collaborate with Project Managers and field teams to ensure a smooth transition from estimating to construction
* Maintain accurate estimating records, pricing information, and bid documentation

**Requirements**
----------------

* 3–5+ years of commercial construction estimating experience, preferably with a general contractor
* Strong background in commercial tenant improvements, hospitality, restaurant construction, or interior renovations
* Experience preparing detailed estimates, quantity

* Perform quantity take-offs, develop pricing, document assumptions and risks, and evaluate subcontractor and supplier proposals.

* Provide constructability input, including guidance on project phasing, means and methods, and potential cost impacts.
* Partner with Engineering, Operations, Sales, Procurement, and project teams throughout the estimating and project development process.
* Participate in site surveys, design reviews, project handoffs, and other project development activities as needed.
* Support procurement and tender activities during project development and construction.

The AP & AR Specialist is responsible for ensuring that the accounting system accurately and promptly reflects what the company owes and what it has earned. The position owns accounts payable and the assigned accounts receivable functions. It ensures expenses are properly coded, documented, reconciled, and paid on time, and that completed work and approved changes become timely, accurate customer billings.

The role directly impacts cash flow, cash-flow planning, job-cost accuracy, month-end reporting, vendor relationships, and the company’s ability to understand true project profitability. The objective is not speed alone, but accurate, efficient, and consistent processing that keeps the books as close to real time as practical. * Work with Project Managers and Foremen to obtain missing job, phase, task, PO, approval, or supporting information.
* Scan and match invoices, packing slips, and POs; enter approved invoices into Foundation with support attached and maintain organized electronic records.

This is an estimating and quoting role first, and a sales role second. Every quote at Diamond runs through this seat, whether it came from our outside sales rep, our Director of Service, a bid board, or a contractor who called in cold. The number has to be right, and it has to go out the same day.

You own a job from the moment it is found until it is sold and handed to Service. The first phone call, the questions that define the scope, the quote, the follow-up, and the handoff to dispatch all sit with you. You are the first impression most customers get of us.

The phone rings all day and priorities move. This seat fields inbound calls and email requests, carries a large book of open quotes at a time, and one crew hitting something unexpected in the field can reshuffle your afternoon. If you want a predictable desk, this is not it.

What You Will Do

* Own inbound customer requests and respond the same day.
* Confirm scope, location, access, timing, and special requirements before you quote. Call the client back the same day for anything missing, and ask the questions that change the number.
* Prepare and send quotes for the whole team.
* Follow up on every open quote you own until it is won or lost, and review the losses to find out why.
* Seek out new work daily through bid platforms and other lead sources.

headlined_rolled.title: Construction Cost Estimator
headlined_rolled.desc:
### **You Know the Difference Between a Number that Wins the Job and a Number That Holds Up** **You have probably seen it before.**

An estimate gets approved, the contract gets signed, and construction starts.

Then the misses show up.

A scope nobody priced. A trade quote that left something out. An allowance that was never realistic. Two subs covering the same work, and nobody covering the work in between.

Now the project team is explaining a change order to a client who thought they already had a real number.

That is not how you like to work.

You believe a good estimate is more than a spreadsheet. It takes reading the drawings closely, understanding how a remodel actually gets built, asking the trades the right questions, and tying every line back to a clear scope.

If that sounds like you, HHI Builders may be a place where you can do some of your best work.

We are a growing design-build remodeling company on Hilton Head Island specializing in high-end residential renovations, additions, and whole-home transformations.

We are looking for an Estimator who wants ownership of the numbers and wants to see their estimates carried all the way from the first budget through the finished home.  
  
**Compensation**

$75,000 - $95,000 yearly base salary, based on experience, plus a performance bonus: a percentage of every project you estimate, based on that project's profitability.

Medical insurance through Blue Cross Blue Shield, with HHI Builders paying 50% of the employee premium. Paid time off and paid company holidays.  
  
**You May Be a Great Fit If...**

You are the type of estimator who naturally asks:

“What is not on these drawings that still has to be paid for?”

You read a trade partner's proposal line by line, including the exclusions.

You would rather make one more phone call than carry a guess into a contract.

You enjoy building real relationships with trade partners and suppliers.

You care about scope, quantities, unit costs, and documentation.

COMMISSION-ONLY, 1099 INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR POSITION. There is no base pay, hourly wage, or guaranteed income. The $0.01 hourly figure shown by Indeed is a placeholder only. You are paid commission on each job you sign that is completed and whose deposit has cleared. Commission amounts vary by service and are set out in a written commission schedule that you receive before you start.

About Us

Pool Armor Pros LLC is a licensed and insured pool service and exterior cleaning company based in Cape Coral, FL, serving nine Southwest Florida cities. We offer pool and spa service, pressure washing, house washing, roof washing, paver and concrete sealing, solar panel cleaning, and epoxy garage flooring.

What You Will Do

- Knock on doors in assigned Cape Coral neighborhoods and introduce our services

- Collect homeowner contact and property information

- Measure the property with our estimating app on a company iPad and give an estimated price

- Take photos for the estimate and upload them to the estimate

- Hand every lead to the office. The office sends the written quote and the customer approves and pays through our customer portal

What You Will Not Do

- Collect deposits, payments, or card information. Reps never handle customer money.

- Solicit before your permit is issued, or at any home posted "No Soliciting"

How Commission Works

- You earn commission on each job you sign, paid after the customer's deposit clears

- Commission is set per service, for example pool service sign-ups, house washing, roof washing, solar panel cleaning, driveway and paver sealing, and epoxy garage floors

- Higher-ticket services pay higher commission
